visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a blurred close-up of a chocolate cruller donut against a city background, with large text overlays. (2) A wide aerial shot shows the busy Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo with crowds of pedestrians and traffic. (3) The camera captures the exterior of the 'Cream or Cruller' shop, a modern glass building where several customers are standing at the counter. (4) A hand holds up a single, golden-brown cruller donut with a twisted, circular shape in front of an outdoor seating area. (5) The hand then presents two crullers together: one original golden-brown and one dark chocolate, highlighting their textures. (6) A close-up shows the cruller being dipped into a small container of light pink cream, followed by a shot of the cream-covered pastry. (7) The scene shifts to the shop's interior, showing metal trays filled with crullers and a digital scale on the counter. (8) A woman with dark hair tied back is shown outdoors, holding a cruller and a cup of pink cream, smiling warmly at the camera. (9) She takes a large bite of the cream-dipped cruller, expressing enjoyment through her facial expression. (10) The camera shows the storefront of 'Kenyan,' a tea shop with a red awning, followed by a hand holding a plastic cup of iced milk tea. (11) A wooden table is seen with bags, coffee cups, and different colored cream dips. (12) The video ends with a pink and white graphic card featuring social media handles and 'Follow me' icons.
